method.scenario: Synthetic direct Boss 2/open reactor; same native clocks, artificial collision protection and boss health floor. No gestures in the measured phase.
sequence: 60 seconds active baseline with live reactor volleys
method.exportedData: Numeric counters, constructor identifiers, snapshot self-size/type aggregates and bounded class differences; no strings, DOM markup, account values or reference edges.
method.snapshotClassSelection: Original aggregates export at most 150 largest classes per snapshot. Receipt retains their 20 largest and the full exported difference. No dominator retained sizes or retaining paths were computed.
method.environment: Linux Chromium/software CI; not physical Pi Browser, OS screenshot or native navigation. Development and production are separate exploratory runs, not an exact controlled benchmark.
method.reactDevelopmentVersion: Not recorded at that tested head; do not infer it from a different local install. Production runtime versions and actual browser import.meta.env flags were recorded.
method.gcScope: Explicit debugger collection plus paused snapshots perturbs allocation/collection. This is diagnostic evidence, not a release-time GC solution or stability acceptance.

development.buildModeEvidence: Vite createServer default at this tested head; explicit browser mode flags and dependency versions were added later and are not retroactively claimed.

excludedSetupRun.reason: The new profiler initially treated legitimate modal-history navigation on Pause as a replaced document. Corrected to compare the boot token and reject real document requests/replacements. The failed setup is not an application crash or accepted profile.

originalFrontendReleaseTests.scope: Earlier completed validation of unchanged game runtime; not a newly repeated 508-test run for these lab-only changes.

supported: Large parts of the measured process-memory increase are collectable in both profiles.
Development final paused PSS falls 949.81 to 526.86 MiB on explicit GC; production falls 642.14 to 418.57 MiB.
Post-GC baseline PSS still rises by 86.41 MiB in development and 37.47 MiB in production over this short observation. This residual is not explained away.

Post-GC DOM/listener counts grow modestly rather than retaining the large transient active counts. Visible images and canvases remain one and three; reported effects-audio sample buffers remain 6925568 bytes. These counters do not cover all browser-native resources.

The development exported snapshot difference includes 15155 PerformanceMeasure instances. Production sampled timeline measure counts are zero. React development code includes performance.measure calls; project frontend/src has none. React documents development instrumentation overhead. This is an influence on laboratory interpretation, not quantified attribution of all growth.
